ttl.name: Propeller Shaft with Center Bearing Assembly (4WD)

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Propeller Shaft with Center Bearing Assembly

s2.ptxt: Using a dial indicator and V-blocks, measure the runout of the front propeller shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Install the dial indicator at a right angle to the center of the shaft.
